messages.subject: barplot
parts:
Hello
I would like someone to help me.
I would like to put each value (25,75,80,10) in the center of each bar). thank you in advance

global1=25
sante1=80

global2=75
sante2=10

moyennes<-c(global1,sante1,
            global2,sante2)

typec=c("Global","Sante")

data3<-list(moyennes,typec)
moyennes=matrix(data3[[1]],nc=2,byrow = T)
colnames(moyennes)=data3[[2]]

  bpp<-barplot(moyennes,beside = F,border = T,las=1,col=c("#A5260A","steelblue"),horiz = T, axes=F,ylim=c(0,3))
  text(x= moyennes, y= bpp, pos=4,labels=as.character(moyennes), font = 1,cex=0.9)
  axis(side=2,tick=T,at=c(0,3),labels=F,tck=0,pos=0)
  legend("bottom",border=F,legend=c("Agriculture","planification"),fill=c("#A5260A","steelblue"),inset = c(0.06,-0.15),bg=NA ,xpd=NA, bty="n",horiz = T)
